- Pupil premium funding (targeted school funding for disadvantaged pupils)
- Closing the disadvantage gap (educational equity/attainment gap)

The core mechanism is **targeted educational funding (pupil premium) to reduce educational disadvantage gaps** — this is squarely about education policy and institutions (I2), with a secondary dimension of welfare/poverty reduction (I3) given the explicit focus on disadvantage.
